headline: Nevish Line Erupts Anew; Colonial Posts Cut to One
war_summary: Three hours have brought fresh fury to the Nevish Line. Twenty base actions in the past two hours — sixty-nine in a day — have cut the Colonials to a single post there, one holding demolished outright, while casualties run near eight hundred an hour on each side and Princefal, Blackcoat Way, Grief Mother and Blinding Stones take the worst of it. Weathered Expanse, the war's costliest ground, now shows four Colonial posts against two Warden and three ruined, with Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance still the busiest points and casualty rates climbing steeply by the hour. In Kuura Strand one Colonial holding has been torn down, five standing, and Faden Point and Talven remain contested. Linn Mercy's flags have not moved since late morning, yet casualty rolls above six hundred an hour point to fierce work near Lathair. Marban Hollow has been flag-quiet since mid-morning; Stlican Shelf since mid-afternoon, though its losses climb. Callahans Passage, too, bleeds heavily without a single flag event. Thirty-four victory towns remain the prize; no victor is declared.
